actual: Lane K pass, Cricmax - Home Location. The Pay later flow has no facility-facing surface in this build. In the roster enrol dialog ("Add existing athlete"), adding an athlete only creates a Pending enrolment ("QA Roster 01 added to the roster (pending activation)"); row actions offer only "View athlete", "Mark active" and "Cancel enrollment"; the "Mark active" dialog says "Activate QA Roster 01's enrollment? This reserves their session credits and admits them to the class." — no payment option and no due date. The class has no price/term fee (see QXR-576), so "Mark paid" amounts and totals cannot be exercised. Clicking the roster's Payment cell ("Not set") opens the athlete profile (Overview, Guardians, Attendance, Payments, Consent & Waivers, Coach Notes) with no Pay later enrolment. Settings (all tabs checked) and Billing show no "Pay later" policy card with deadline/outcome/reminders; Billing is an invoices-only page.
expected: Enrol with Pay later shows "Awaiting payment · {days} days" and the child can attend; Mark paid validates the amount; a Pay later policy card in Settings holds deadline, outcome and reminders.
steps: Open a class roster > Add existing athlete; enrol with Pay later and note the result.
Use the row actions (Mark active) and read the dialog.
Click the roster Payment cell and check the athlete profile.
Check Settings (all tabs) and Billing for a Pay later policy card.
title: QXR-586: no Pay later facility surface — roster enrol only creates a Pending enrolment, no payment option or policy card
